name: Mummy
summary: An embalmed undead whose rotting touch curses and whose glare paralyzes with fear.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.onHit: If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by {dmg:3d6} every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare

save.targets: one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.
actions.onSuccess: The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.
